question:
Choose an appropriate word that can substitute the bracketed word and complete the sentence meaningfully.

Shelley was very happy (while) I accepted her invitation to her birthday party.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"while"** means during the time that; at the same time as. (जबकि)

 
 
• **Example: **She read a book **while** waiting for the bus.
 
 
 
• **"when" **refers to at or during the time that. (जब)
 
 
• **Example: **He was very happy **when **he heard the news.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the word** 'when'** is an appropriate substitute for 'while' in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **when**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **As **(जैसे): Used to indicate that something happens during the time that something else is happening.

 
 
• **Example:** She smiled as she walked into the room.
 
 
 
• **Before **(पहले): At an earlier time.
 
 
• **Example: **He finished his homework before dinner.
 
 
 
• **After** (बाद में): Following in time.
 
 
• **Example:** She went for a walk after lunch.
